title: Settings
description: Workspace and personal settings. Workspace changes apply to everyone and are recorded in the audit log.

period.title: Reporting period
period.description: The period people are collecting data for now. Lock and publish it from Reporting cycles.
period.emptyBody: Create the fiscal year you're reporting on so assignments can collect values.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: People, structure, access and the record of who changed what.

users.label: Users & roles
users.hint: Invite people and set what each role can do

periods.label: Reporting cycles
periods.hint: Open, lock and publish fiscal years

apiKeys.label: API keys
apiKeys.hint: Programmatic access for BI and ERP sync

scim.label: SCIM provisioning
scim.hint: Sync people from your identity provider

audit.label: Audit log
audit.hint: Every change, who made it and when

frameworks.heading: Frameworks
frameworks.intro: Choose which frameworks this workspace reports against. {{name}} is the active framework; turn on others as you need them.
frameworks.keepOne: Keep at least one framework turned on.

notifications.heading: Email notifications
notifications.intro: Your own email alerts. Changes save as you make them.

assignment.label: Email me when I'm assigned a disclosure
assignment.description: Sent when an admin assigns you a disclosure to fill in.

review.label: Email me when a submission needs my review
review.description: Sent when a value is submitted and waiting for you to review or approve.

anomaly.label: Email me about anomalies in my scope
anomaly.description: Triggered when the anomaly engine flags a value you own.

notifications.digestHint: How often Nexus rolls your notifications into a single summary email.

channels.title: Team channels
channels.description: Post workflow notifications to DingTalk, Feishu or WeCom group robots. One robot per app; URLs and secrets are stored encrypted and never shown again.

ai.readOnly: Only workspace admins can change AI settings.

status.title: What's running
status.description: The provider and model this workspace uses for AI drafting, extraction and gap analysis.

deploymentOff.title: AI is switched off for this deployment
deploymentOff.body: Your Nexus operator has turned AI off on the server, so it can't be enabled here.

notConfigured.title: {{provider}} is not configured on the server
notConfigured.body: The server has no credentials for this provider, so AI features stay unavailable. Ask your Nexus operator to add them, or choose a provider that is configured.

controls.title: Controls
controls.description: Turn AI off entirely, or choose which provider drafts content. Changes apply to everyone in the workspace.

enabled.label: Use AI in this workspace
enabled.hint: When off, AI drafting, document extraction and narrative suggestions are hidden for everyone.

provider.label: Provider
provider.hint: Mainland China workspaces should use a mainland provider so prompts and data stay onshore.

anthropic.name: Anthropic (global)
anthropic.body: Claude models, hosted outside mainland China.

openai_compatible.name: Mainland provider
openai_compatible.body: OpenAI-compatible mainland models such as Qwen or DeepSeek.

toast.off: AI turned off for this workspace

export.heading: Data export
export.body: Download a portable zip of everything we hold for this workspace — users, facilities, activity data, assignments, data values, workflow tasks, notifications, reports, and the audit log. Password hashes, MFA secrets, and SCIM/API token hashes are never included.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Your own choice; it doesn't change anyone else's. Emails and group notifications to you follow it too.
language.saveFailed: Language changed here, but not saved for emails
language.saveFailedHint: Emails and notifications keep your previous language until it saves. Try again later.

server.title: Emails and notifications
server.description: What Nexus uses when it writes to you outside the app.
server.resolved: Emails and notifications to you are written in {{language}}.
server.following: No saved preference: following your browser and the workspace market.

display.heading: Display
display.intro: Tune appearance and information density. Light is paper-clean for daytime; dark is easier on the eyes after hours. Comfortable suits review; Compact lets power users squeeze more rows into a single view.
display.appearanceHint: Light is paper-clean for daytime work. Auto follows your OS preference and switches when your system flips between light and dark.
display.densityHint: Applies instantly across the whole workspace.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.intro: Switch between the demo flat theme and the legacy Nexus Glass UI.

demoFlat.label: Demo Flat
demoFlat.description: Default. Emerald brand, flat paper surfaces, WCAG 2.1 AA.

glass.label: Glass UI
glass.description: Nexus legacy. Soft shadows, blurred surfaces, rounded corners.
